name: Ningbo KBE Electrical Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningbo KBE Electrical Technology Co.,Ltd. is an enterprise dedicated to the development, manufacturing, and distribution of wire and cable products specifically designed for the automotive industry. The company serves both the domestic Chinese market and international clients. Its comprehensive product line features advanced cables for electric vehicles (EVs), data transmission, and aluminum applications, all produced in compliance with various global standards including German, Japanese, American, ISO, and Chinese specifications. These specialized products are primarily supplied to manufacturers of automotive wiring harnesses. Founded in 1986, the company's main operational base is located in Ninghai, China. Moreover, Ningbo KBE Electrical Technology Co.,Ltd. functions as a subsidiary of Ningbo Xinxie Industrial Group Co., Ltd.
